record.question: The number of Biodiversity Hotspots in the world is
record.explanation: The European Commission Joint Research Centre catalog for the Biodiversity Hotspots version 2016.1 dataset identifies 36 global hotspots, consistent with option (d) in this 2017 reproduction. Hotspots require at least 1,500 endemic vascular-plant species and loss of at least 70% of original native vegetation. The catalog marks this archived dataset “Not Updated”; it is not a fresh survey. Reference: https://africa-knowledge-platform.ec.europa.eu/dataset/biodiversity-hotspots .
